status: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY (Wave 1b pre-registration S4.2): k is fixed at 3 and 5 by the pre-registration; this sweep cannot change it. Self-play and unpatched forward passes only; no interchange computed.

games_recorded.meaning: games that reached their (k+1)-th placement (a random prefix can end in a win when k >= 4)

distinct_games.meaning: distinct (board, piece) at the (k+1)-th placement; the continuation is deterministic, so this is the number of different games

positions_per_game.meaning: recorded placement decisions per game, before dedup

unique.meaning: positions after within-set dedup on exact (board, piece)

removed_fresh.meaning: unique positions dropped because their board, up to symmetry, is a pilot pair's board

any_threat.meaning: fraction of positions with a line/square of 3 sharing a value and one empty cell

win_available.meaning: fraction where the piece in hand can win now (tiger_win_now_exists)

powered_in_every_arm.meaning: concepts whose switch-on, specificity and switch-off pair counts all reach n_min (100/100/50)

IIA.meaning: share of pairs whose patched legal decision lands in the target set

r0.meaning: share of pairs whose UNPATCHED base decision already lands in the target set

flip_rate.meaning: share of pairs whose legal decision changes at all under the patch

target_margin.meaning: change in the best target logit minus the mean change of the other legal actions
